body:
Correct the benchmark mutation-replay description to the implemented 15-table comparison list, document the existing component ownership and compatibility evidence, and explain how to recompute native reports in an independent copy of retained evidence.

The replay instructions distinguish archive integrity verification from numerical recomputation, select actual per-suite run directories, preserve the original archive and candidate-bound gate, and retain the replay tool identity, exit code, and output differences.

Scope: exactly three documentation paths at head `335237cf35f0972431fc37a8c6237a1ae51dbd75`, parent/main `a406a4968c46ab005225666e60e81acddaa77de8`:
- `docs/BENCHMARK.md`: correct the linked mutation-replay comparison count from 14 to 15 tables. The separate 14 MCP tools count stays unchanged.
- `docs/roadmap/code-index-v2/P8-OWNERSHIP.md`: document component ownership, actual retained/removed interfaces, and existing compatibility evidence with their original source identities.
- `docs/roadmap/code-index-v2/P8-RELEASE-EVIDENCE.md`: clarify native evidence replay and retention of original gates and failure states.

The exact three-file diff and references received independent scope reviews. These three paths are outside protected v15/history inputs; task status, acceptance definitions, source guards, registries, workloads and budgets are unchanged. This PR grants no original task-completion credit. Current main remains 164/192 complete, 28 remaining; this session has newly completed P8-005 only.

## Validation and documented process difference

New-head CI is running at https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38002699110. At the 23:30 UTC observation, formatting, Clippy, compilation of all default test targets, the authorized default regression, the fixed-resource/TODO consistency controls, semantic HTTP/stdin capability checks and eval suite had passed; later main-job checks were still pending. Eighteen of the 21 check runs were successful, one was in progress and two DB observational checks were conditionally skipped. Final results will be recorded before merge.

`CONTRIBUTING.md` asks numerical documentation changes to run `scripts/update-doc-baselines.sh`. That script is explicitly **not_run** for this PR. Its actual command runs `cargo test --workspace --all-targets`, which would execute targets beyond the current CI's selected execution scope; its numerical comparisons concern TEST_PLAN test/corpus counts and do not validate this 15-table oracle list. The small documentation correction is verified against the actual comparison-list source, and those separate baseline counts are unchanged. This is a documented bounded process difference, not a claim that the script or its full test selection passed. No simulated output or replacement gate is used.

Existing successful product/validation evidence at `b8ab8ecdc5b32993fc02ce43877b7e172b8a4b3f` retains its original execution identity. The recorded main scope bridge covers the exact intervening five documentation changes; it does not relabel that earlier execution as this head. Root scope/process proof is retained on the checkpoint branch at `0727385f83c143043dca3f68fb85baebac3168df`.
